about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for the chart calibration probe (row LK-calibration-holes, night1-20260926 triage scratchpad/n1/night1-triage.md §2). Each example is a real probe key from tests/gauntlet/chart_render.py:PROBE against the synthetic PFM chart, whose pipeline is colorin/colorout/gamma only -- sigmoid, exposure and temperature never have an active history entry on it. Run by tests/intent/test_looks_calibration_probe_intent.py.
subject: tests/gauntlet/exec_looks.py chart_golden + plan_moves, scouter/core/vocab.py ParamSpec.default / default_candidate

examples.source: night-1 golden-case audit (looks/001, 23:21): 'exposure.black' -> value_unknown 'did not decode from the XMP' on a relative darkroom_adjust; the probe sets 0.0 + -0.01 = -0.01 absolutely instead of adjusting a delta with nothing to add it to. Row 474 (final-review issue I1) found the phase3 design spec's own §4.3 table leaves this row's `default` column blank by design, so until a host probe confirmed the value scouter/core/vocab.py declared it only as a `default_candidate` and the measured slope was recorded as calibration_errors['exposure.black'] = 'default_unverified' (never planned). Row 495/496: tests/test_host_phase3.py's ProbeExposureBlackDefaultHostTest host-verified it (a fresh exposure module's black lands within darktable's slot-floor quantisation, vocab.EXPOSURE_BLACK_QUANT, of 0.0), promoting it to a cited `default=0.0` -- the probe now reads it via that branch, is no longer flagged unverified, and plan_moves DOES plan a black-point move from the measured slope

night-1 evidence: 'adjust on an absent colorbalancergb works (0% -> 10%)' because vocab.py's _cb() rows declare neutral=0.0; switching every PROBE key to an absolute set keeps this row working the same way, from the same declared value

night-1 golden-case audit: 'no active temperature entry' -- the PFM chart carries no EXIF and no white-balance module, so there is no honest Kelvin to declare as a default (scouter/core/vocab.py leaves temperature.temperature's neutral and default both None); chart_golden must record this as a calibration_errors entry, not silently compute a falsy 0.0 slope that plan_moves then reads as 'no calibration' with no trace of why
